workarounds.symptom: [PYSEC-2026-2604] Litestar has HTML Injection Through its CSRF Token (Affects litestar < 2.22.0)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade litestar to patched release >= 2.22.0: pip install --upgrade 'litestar>=2.22.0' (Advisory: PYSEC-2026-2604)

workarounds.symptom: [PYSEC-2026-2605] Litestar and Starlite vulnerable to Path Traversal (Affects litestar < 2.8.3)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade litestar to patched release >= 2.8.3: pip install --upgrade 'litestar>=2.8.3' (Advisory: PYSEC-2026-2605)

workarounds.symptom: [PYSEC-2026-1553] Litestar X-Forwarded-For Header Spoofing Vulnerability Enables Rate Limit Evasion (Affects litestar < 2.18.0)
workarounds.workaround: Upgrade litestar to patched release >= 2.18.0: pip install --upgrade 'litestar>=2.18.0' (Advisory: PYSEC-2026-1553)
